findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_location_hours, how_to_report_machine_issue, get_contact_form_link · Private data: get_location_hours, how_to_report_machine_issue, get_contact_form_link · Public sink: get_location_hours, how_to_report_machine_issue, get_contact_form_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_location_hours, how_to_report_machine_issue, get_contact_form_link · Private data: get_location_hours, how_to_report_machine_issue, get_contact_form_link · Public sink: get_location_hours, how_to_report_machine_issue, get_contact_form_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_amenities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
